For every holomorphic mapping \(f\) on a orthogonal space \(X\), there exists a unitary structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that shows that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 3. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1210003}\) acting on the analytic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-analytic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1210003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1210003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via every interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1210001} \cdot C_{1210002} \cdot C_{1210003}\).
